facts.fact: The glass facade faces Jozenji-dori, with distinctive tubes through the structure.
facts.excerpt: full glass facade that looks out on Jozenji-dori Avenue, and pillar-like tubes that pierce the building

facts.fact: The first floor contains OpenSquare; library and galleries occupy different floors.
facts.excerpt: an event space called Open Square

facts.fact: The building and library have distinct closing arrangements; current facility information is needed.
facts.excerpt: Library is closed Mondays, or on Tuesday when a national holiday falls on a Monday
